facts.text: The resort is set within a private community in New Cairo, Egypt.
facts.excerpt: set within a prestigious private community in New Cairo, Egypt

facts.text: The resort has a 27-hole championship golf course designed by Sir Nick Faldo and Brian Curley.
facts.excerpt: a 27-hole championship golf course designed by Sir Nick Faldo and Brian Curley

facts.text: A Golf Academy with extensive practice facilities supports the course.
facts.excerpt: The Golf Academy boasts the very latest in teaching equipment technology and is complemented by extensive practice facilities

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites look out over the fairways.
facts.excerpt: Choose from thoughtfully appointed guest rooms and suites offering serene views of lush fairways.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has golf course views and a private pool.
facts.excerpt: reserve our Presidential Suite with breathtaking golf course views and a private pool

facts.text: The Westin Suite has a private balcony overlooking the gardens.
facts.excerpt: saunter out onto your private balcony and breathe in the fragrance of tropical blossoms from the gardens around

facts.text: Each treatment room at the Heavenly Spa has its own landscaping and personal shower.
facts.excerpt: The 10 beautifully single therapy rooms and 2 Couple Suites are designed to create a feeling of bliss. Each treatment room features unique landscaping and personal shower

facts.text: The Heavenly Spa has a steam room, a rain shower, a swimming pool and a whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: State-of-the-art modern spa facilities are also in the Heavenly Spa™, including a high-tech steam room, “Rain Shower”, swimming pool and whirlpool.

facts.text: Spa treatments draw on Asian techniques such as traditional Chinese medicine and Thai massage.
facts.excerpt: The menu is an array of wellness treatments from Asia, such as techniques from traditional Chinese Medicine and Thai massage

facts.text: Body scrubs and wraps use local organic products.
facts.excerpt: using local organic products for body scrubs and wraps

facts.text: Maré Social has indoor and outdoor seating overlooking the golf course.
facts.excerpt: Maré Social provides an inviting atmosphere both indoors and outdoors, overlooking the golf course

facts.text: Maré Social is a taberna-style restaurant and bar inspired by chef Henrique Sá Pessoa.
facts.excerpt: Maré Social is an intimate taberna-style restaurant and bar inspired by Two Star Michelin Chef Henrique Sá Pessoa

facts.text: The swimming pool is at the heart of the resort's outdoor spaces.
facts.excerpt: The Swimming Pool is at the heart of the outdoor luxury

facts.text: The resort is near Cairo International Airport.
facts.excerpt: Located near Cairo International Airport, The Westin Cairo Golf Resort & Spa, Katameya Dunes is set within a prestigious residential community in New Cairo.

facts.text: Guests can plan visits to the Museum of Egyptian Antiquities and the Pyramids and Sphinx of Giza.
facts.excerpt: History enthusiasts can explore the treasures of the Museum of Egyptian Antiquities or plan a visit to the Pyramids and the Sphinx of Giza.
